# Tours Alegría

> Tours Alegría runs small-group, all-inclusive day trips in El Salvador with hotel pickup in Surf City (El Tunco and El Zonte), from $120 per person.

## What we do
Tours Alegría is a young Salvadoran travel startup run by three friends from Surf City. We take small groups on all-inclusive day trips to waterfalls, regenerative farms, cacao and coffee farms, Lake Coatepeque, Suchitoto and the Montecristo cloud forest. Every trip includes hotel pickup, transport and lunch.

## Tours
- [Tamanique Waterfalls and Organic Farm Lunch](https://toursalegria.com/tamanique-waterfalls-tour): A morning of waterfalls, then a slow farm lunch made with what grows right there. 6 hours, $120 per person.
- [Comasagua Regenerative Farm: Cacao, Microgreens and Brunch](https://toursalegria.com/comasagua-regenerative-farm-tour): Slow down in the mountains of La Libertad. Share cacao, grow microgreens, walk the farm. 8.5 hours, $120 per person.
- [Cerro Verde and Lake Coatepeque](https://toursalegria.com/cerro-verde-lake-coatepeque-tour): Cool mountain air in the morning, a lazy afternoon by the most beautiful lake in El Salvador. 11 hours, $175 per person.
- [Organic Cacao and Coffee Experience](https://toursalegria.com/cacao-coffee-tour): From the tree to the cup: two farms, an ocean-view lunch and the people behind the flavors. 9 hours, $230 per person.
- [Surf and Yoga Morning in Mizata](https://toursalegria.com/surf-yoga-mizata-tour): Uncrowded waves, yoga by the sea and a healthy brunch. A morning that fills you with energy. 7.5 hours, $135 per person.
- [Cihuatán Rum Tour and Suchitoto](https://toursalegria.com/rum-suchitoto-tour): See how Salvadoran rum is made, then wander the cobbled streets of Suchitoto. 10 hours, $145 per person.
- [El Limo and Montecristo: 2-Day Trip](https://toursalegria.com/el-limo-montecristo-2-day-tour): Two days between hidden waterfalls and a century-old cloud forest. 2 days, 1 night, $400 per person.

## Problems we solve
- You want to see the real El Salvador beyond the beach, but do not want to organize transport, food and guides yourself: we pick you up at your hotel and include everything.
- You want calm, comfortable trips with good care: small groups and a team that takes care of everything.
- You care about wellness and the planet: organic and regenerative farms, local producers and nature.

## Who it is for
International travelers staying in Surf City, El Salvador (El Tunco, El Zonte and nearby beaches) who want authentic, comfortable and all-inclusive experiences: couples, solo travelers, and people who love nature, food, culture, surf and yoga.

## Key facts
- Based in Surf City, La Libertad, El Salvador.
- Founded by three Salvadoran friends: Rousse, Kaleb and Melissa.
- Minimum 2 guests per trip. Trips run any day on request.
- Every trip includes hotel pickup, lunch or brunch and cold water.
- Service in English and Spanish. Airport transfers available.

## Our story
We are Rousse, Kaleb and Melissa, three friends from El Salvador. Rousse is a doctor, Kaleb is a civil engineer and Melissa studied tourism. What brings us together is surfing. It became our way of life, and the ocean taught us to flow with life's challenges the same way we ride waves.
We love El Salvador: the food, the landscapes and the people. That is why we started Tours Alegría, to share our country in an authentic way, with trips that tell stories and take you to places where nature is cared for and respected.
We believe in a more conscious planet. On every tour you will find activities that are good for your body, your soul and the Earth.

## How we work
We pick you up at your hotel, travel in small groups and take care of everything: transport, lunch and cold water on the way. You just enjoy the day.

## The Alegría touch (included on every trip)
- Hotel pickup and drop-off: We pick you up at your hotel in Surf City and bring you back.
- Cold water all day: A cooler with cold bottled water always travels with us.
- Lunch included: Real local food, so you never have to reach for your wallet.

## Tamanique Waterfalls and Organic Farm Lunch
URL: https://toursalegria.com/tamanique-waterfalls-tour
Price: $120 per person
Duration: 6 hours (8:00 am to 2:00 pm)
Effort: Active. A 3-hour hike to four waterfalls. Good shoes and a swimsuit are a great idea.

Feel the cool water and the jungle around you as you hike to the four waterfalls of Tamanique with a local guide. Then slow down at the Orgánicos de Tamanique farm, where lunch is made with fresh, local and regenerative ingredients. You are back at your hotel around 2 pm.

Itinerary:
- 8:00 am: Hotel pickup in Surf City. About 30 minutes to Tamanique.
- 8:30 am: Guided hike to the 4 Waterfalls of Tamanique (3 hours).
- 11:30 am: Short drive to the Orgánicos de Tamanique farm.
- 12:00 pm: Organic, regenerative lunch at the farm (1.5 hours).
- 1:30 pm: Drive back to Surf City.
- 2:00 pm: Back at your hotel.

Includes:
- Round-trip transport from your hotel
- Local guide and bilingual guide on the hike
- Park entrance fee
- Organic, regenerative lunch at Orgánicos de Tamanique

## Comasagua Regenerative Farm: Cacao, Microgreens and Brunch
URL: https://toursalegria.com/comasagua-regenerative-farm-tour
Price: $120 per person
Duration: 8.5 hours (6:30 am to 3:00 pm)
Effort: Easy. Gentle walking around the farm. Good for most fitness levels.

This is a day to reconnect. In the cool mountains of Comasagua you open with a cacao circle and organic fruit, learn to grow your own microgreens, share an organic brunch and walk through every crop of Finca El Pegoste. Everything is included (transport, meals and drinks), so you will not need to spend anything extra.

Itinerary:
- 6:30 am: Hotel pickup. About 1 hour and 15 minutes to Comasagua.
- 8:00 am: Cacao circle and organic fruit.
- 9:00 am: Hands-on class: grow your own microgreens.
- 11:00 am: Organic, regenerative brunch.
- 12:30 pm: Guided walk through the crops of Finca El Pegoste.
- 2:00 pm: Drive back.
- 3:00 pm: Back at your hotel.

Includes:
- Round-trip transport from your hotel
- Cacao circle and organic fruit tasting
- Hands-on microgreens workshop
- Organic, regenerative brunch
- Guided walk through Finca El Pegoste
- Our company during the whole experience

## Cerro Verde and Lake Coatepeque
URL: https://toursalegria.com/cerro-verde-lake-coatepeque-tour
Price: $175 per person
Duration: 11 hours (6:00 am to 5:00 pm)
Effort: Easy. A light, easy hike. The rest of the day is pure relaxing.

A calm day made for enjoying. Start with a traditional breakfast and a light walk in Cerro Verde, with its fresh climate and big views. Then spend the afternoon at Cardedeu, on the shore of Lake Coatepeque: eat, paddle a kayak, swim or simply do nothing at all.

Itinerary:
- 6:00 am: Hotel pickup and drive to Cerro Verde.
- 8:00 am: Traditional Salvadoran breakfast at Cerro Verde.
- 9:00 am: Light hike in Cerro Verde.
- 10:00 am: Drive to Cardedeu, on the shore of Lake Coatepeque.
- 11:00 am: Day pass at Cardedeu: lunch, kayak and time to relax, until 3 pm.
- 3:00 pm: Drive back to Playa El Tunco.
- 5:00 pm: Back in Surf City.

Includes:
- Round-trip transport from your hotel
- Traditional breakfast
- $20 credit for lunch or drinks at Cardedeu
- Access to the common areas and facilities of Cardedeu
- 30 minutes of kayaking on Lake Coatepeque

## Organic Cacao and Coffee Experience
URL: https://toursalegria.com/cacao-coffee-tour
Price: $230 per person
Duration: 9 hours (8:30 am to 5:30 pm)
Effort: Easy. Easy farm walks. Good for any fitness level.

Taste two of the most iconic products of El Salvador where they are born. In the morning you walk an organic cacao farm on the coast of La Libertad and taste cacao, coconut water and fresh fruit. After lunch with an ocean view, you climb to the cool mountains of the Cordillera del Bálsamo to visit a coffee farm and meet the people who grow it.

Itinerary:
- 8:30 am: Hotel pickup.
- 9:00 am: Guided tour of Finca Varsovia, an organic cacao farm in San Diego, La Libertad (2.5 hours).
- 11:30 am: Drive to Tomadulu.
- 12:10 pm: Lunch with an ocean view at Tomadulu.
- 1:30 pm: Drive up to the Cordillera del Bálsamo.
- 2:30 pm: Coffee farm tour (Finca Montealegre or Finca Cumpas) with coffee tasting and quesadilla de arroz (2 hours).
- 4:30 pm: Drive back.
- 5:30 pm: Back at your hotel.

Includes:
- Round-trip tourist transport
- Guided tour of Finca Varsovia
- Cacao, coconut water and fresh fruit tasting
- Lunch at a restaurant with an ocean view
- Guided visit to a coffee farm in the Cordillera del Bálsamo
- Coffee tasting with a sweet treat
- Our company during the whole day

## Surf and Yoga Morning in Mizata
URL: https://toursalegria.com/surf-yoga-mizata-tour
Price: $135 per person
Duration: 7.5 hours (6:00 am to 1:30 pm)
Effort: Active. Made for intermediate surfers who can already catch waves on their own.

Wake up with the ocean. You surf an uncrowded point break in Mizata with a local surfer who knows the wave by heart, then breathe and stretch in a yoga session by the sea. The morning closes with a healthy brunch at El Pausa, and you are back by 1:30 pm.

Itinerary:
- 6:00 am: Hotel pickup and drive to Mizata.
- 7:00 am: Surf an uncrowded point break with a local surfer (2 hours, intermediate level).
- 9:00 am: Short drive to the yoga space.
- 9:15 am: Fresh fruit and a moment to set your intention.
- 9:30 am: Yoga by the sea (1 hour).
- 10:45 am: Drive to El Pausa.
- 11:00 am: Healthy brunch at El Pausa.
- 12:30 pm: Drive back. Back at your hotel around 1:30 pm.

Includes:
- Intermediate surf session with a local surfer
- Yoga session by the sea
- Healthy brunch at El Pausa
- A relaxed, small-group vibe

## Cihuatán Rum Tour and Suchitoto
URL: https://toursalegria.com/rum-suchitoto-tour
Price: $145 per person
Duration: 10 hours (7:00 am to 5:00 pm)
Effort: Easy. Easy walking. The longest part is the drive, in a comfortable van.

A day of history, culture and real flavor. At the Cihuatán distillery in El Paisnal you follow rum from the sugar cane field through extraction and fermentation to the tasting, and you take a bottle home. Then you head to Suchitoto, a colonial town of cobbled streets, for lunch and a slow walk through its history.

Itinerary:
- 7:00 am: Pickup in Playa El Tunco and drive to El Paisnal.
- 9:00 am: Guided rum tour: sugar cane, extraction, fermentation and tasting.
- 11:00 am: Drive to Suchitoto.
- 12:00 pm: Lunch at a local restaurant in Suchitoto.
- 2:00 pm: Walk through the streets of the old town.
- 3:00 pm: Drive back to Playa El Tunco.
- 5:00 pm: Back in Surf City.

Includes:
- Round-trip transport
- Personalized rum tour
- A 375 ml bottle of Cihuatán Indigo 8 años as a gift
- Lunch in Suchitoto

## El Limo and Montecristo: 2-Day Trip
URL: https://toursalegria.com/el-limo-montecristo-2-day-tour
Price: $400 per person
Duration: 2 days, 1 night (Departure in the morning from Surf City)
Effort: Moderate. A short, accessible waterfall walk on day 1 and a forest hike on day 2.

Leave the beach behind and head into one of the most impressive natural regions of El Salvador. In El Limo you find quiet rural life and a beautiful waterfall. In Montecristo National Park you walk among century-old trees in a cloud forest full of life, one of the best preserved natural treasures in the country.

Itinerary:
- Day 1: Leave Surf City for the mountains of western El Salvador. Short, accessible hike to a beautiful waterfall in El Limo. Traditional lunch: homemade sopa de gallina. Check in to our lodging and enjoy the cool mountain air and starry skies.
- Day 2: Breakfast. Hike into the 100-year-old forest of Montecristo National Park: cloud forest, giant trees and rich biodiversity. Drive back to Surf City.

Includes:
- Round-trip tourist transport
- Pickup in Surf City
- Waterfall hike in El Limo
- Traditional lunch on day 1
- One night of lodging
- Breakfast on day 2
- Visit to Montecristo National Park
- Our company during the whole experience

## Frequently asked questions

### How much do the tours cost?
Day trips cost between $120 and $230 per person. The price includes hotel pickup in Surf City, transport, lunch or brunch, cold water and every activity listed on the trip page. The 2-day El Limo and Montecristo trip includes lodging and meals.

### Where do you pick us up?
At your hotel in Surf City, on the coast of La Libertad: El Tunco, El Zonte and the beaches nearby. Staying somewhere else? Write us on WhatsApp and we will tell you if we can pick you up.

### Which days do the tours run?
Any day, on request, with a minimum of 2 guests per trip. Tell us your dates on WhatsApp and we confirm.

### Can I join if I am traveling alone?
Yes, write us anyway. Our trips run from 2 guests, so we will tell you which dates already have a small group you can join.

### Is food included?
Yes. Every trip includes lunch or brunch and cold water all day, so you do not need to spend extra. Tell us about vegetarian, vegan or allergy needs when you book.

### How physically demanding are the trips?
Each trip shows an effort level. Most are easy, with short walks. The Tamanique waterfalls hike and the surf and yoga morning are the most active. If you have any mobility needs, ask us before you book.

### Is it safe?
Your safety comes first. We travel in our own van with small groups, we know every place we visit, and we always carry a first-aid kit.

### Do you offer airport transfers?
Yes. We also offer transport between the airport and Surf City. Ask us on WhatsApp.

### How do I book and pay?
Use the booking form or write us on WhatsApp with the trip, your dates and how many people are coming. We reply in English or Spanish, confirm availability and send you the payment details.
